name: Stepper
summary: Progress through numbered steps, for a task that happens in a fixed order.

a11y.apg: none: there is no APG pattern for a stepper. The practice adopted is role=list with aria-current="step" on the active one, which is also what the only reference that ships a stepper does.
a11y.keyboardNote: Measured in a browser on 2026-08-27 (apps/keyboard-probe + tests/visual/teclado-motor.spec.ts). Confirmed: Enter, Space.

props.name: items
props.description: REQUIRED. One entry per step: label, state, optional note, and an optional handler. The number comes from the position, so it can never drift.

props.name: items[].state
props.description: `done` shows a check, `error` shows the error glyph in the danger colour, `active` is the one announced as current.

props.name: items[].optional
props.description: A note under the label, for a step that may be skipped.

props.name: items[].onClick
props.description: Makes the step a real button, for a flow the user may enter at any point. Without it the step is not interactive.

props.name: items[].href
props.description: Makes the step a link (in the bar, each part leads to its step).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the whole list.

props.name: variant
props.description: path: a path you choose on — 50 dots (--control-h-xl) on the card with the small shadow, numbers in the code font, one 8 rail (--fill-2) end to end, the chosen step inverted and 56; the labels stay for screen readers; under a 30rem container, four per row and no rail. bar: progress in parts — each step is a 12 part of the bar, 6 apart, the link or button of its step, green when done; the label stays for screen readers.

props.name: startContent / endContent
props.description: path: the two ends that do not click (the start one in the brand yellow). bar: the name before the bar (600) and the count after it (code font, role=status, announced when it changes).

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the outermost element, after the Aurea skin — your class wins on a tie.
